brief.why: Get from a closed game to the player in the level, in control, with no help.
brief.start: Claude launches and presses the launcher's Play; says LISTENING once the game window is up. Press nothing before that.
move: On each screen, BEFORE doing anything: Page Up if it needs a key (then press it), Page Down if it just needs waiting for.
Keyboard only, the way you rehearsed, through to loading your save.
When the player stands in the level and you could move him: Page Down once more.
brief.avoid: Mouse clicks (they are not recorded), moving the player, extra keys after arriving.
